author: potuz
content:
I do feel as there is an inherent tradeoff here that may want to be explored:

On the one hand: restrict at maximum the traffic of this global channel --> only one possible bid per builder can be deemed valid to a given peer, this bid therefore must be compatible with head. 

On the other hand: be more flexible so as more useful bids reach the proposer -> more than one possible bid per builder can be deemed valid per peer -> we must allow more traffic on the channel. 

I do not think there's anything intermediary here and we must decide which path is better. It does seem that enforcing proposer head is more complex than simply enforcing "is valid and less than 3" so I do appreciate the value of not being strict. If people are not afraid of Dossing this channel I think it's fine to go with the latter approach
